what: The approval in headless Chromium with JavaScript (browser-approve.py): the page itself POSTs /wp/v2/users/me/application-passwords (status kept here: that call's answer) and then sets window.location; there is no HTTP redirect. Location is the URL the browser navigated to, exactly as sent, with the password (groups of four separated by spaces, spaces encoded as '%20') replaced by Benc hKey 0123 4567 89AB CDEF in that same encoding. Query fields in order: m, mainwp_return, site_url, user_login, password
